summary.text: Mike Deering is the Republican candidate for Missouri State Senate District 10 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat John Wells.
He is an at-large member of the Montgomery County R-II School District school board, a position he has held since 2024.

paragraphs.text: Mike Deering assumed office on the Montgomery County R-II School District school board in 2024, and his current term ends in 2027.
He advanced from the Republican primary for the State Senate on August 4, 2026.
